system.description:
You are sensitive to the moods and emotions of those around you. When you listen to someone, you understand her feelings, identify with her, and can tell when people are lying or holding back.

With a Social Challenge and the expenditure of an Empathy Ability you can determine whether the last thing someone said was a lie (though Subterfuge defends against this), or attempt to read the subject's current Demeanor.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
